requirements.location: Complete original English task and independent outline units1–6, planned exhibits and open evidence questions.
requirements.basis: The outline retains mainland domestic scope and 2023–cutoff development while keeping overseas results separate. It plans audience and money definitions before growth claims, then decomposes demand and monetization across embedded, mini-program and standalone distribution. Distribution, user relationships, content/IP and acquisition are linked to comparative company cases rather than a fixed roster. The value-flow unit distinguishes cash/revenue, commissions/refunds, financing, margins and explicit scenario assumptions with completion/retention sensitivities. Dated regulatory, copyright/minor/refund requirements enter operating decisions. Participant-specific decisions and reversal conditions integrate the preceding evidence. China-specific concepts are to be explained naturally in English. The author is isolated from the Chinese answer; frozen-material access qualifications are stated. No requested substantive dimension or exhibit is missing at outline stage.
